tx:
▸ Obtaining fragments
In order to create the hatchet, players must first upgrade their Grove cabin to tier 3 in Fort Forinthry, which unlocks the ability to find new bird's nests which may contain Imcando hatchet fragments. Oak will give the player a bird's nest containing an Imcando hatchet fragment once for free when spoken to after upgrading the Grove cabin. There is bad luck mitigation in place; every nest found while woodcutting increases the chance to find a nest that contains an Imcando hatchet fragment.
Receiving hatchet pieces can be toggled through Settings (Skills & Experience, Woodcutting) by checking or unchecking the "Toggle imcando hatchet bird's nests drops" option.
Havenhythe Birdhouses are the quickest way to obtain Imcando Fragments by far. It is recommended to unlock the Bank at Dalia's Tree Nursery, beginning your route here.
Crystal trees, bamboo, and golden bamboo do not award bird's nests. Chopping down trees in Prifddinas when the Voice of Seren is active in the Crwys district will award crystal geodes rather than bird's nests. A bird's nest can be obtained every time the player would receive Woodcutting experience, regardless if the cut is successful or not. Woodcutting experience, and by extension bird's nests, can be obtained every . This essentially means that the type of tree, or the speed at which experience is gained, has no influence on the number of bird's nests received. Cutting elder trees and teleporting using a superior locator or the sentinel outfit is a popular method of finding nests. Cutting overgrown idols can provide a boost that doubles cutting rate (to every ), essentially doubling the rate at which bird's nests can be found while that boost is active.…

Cutting eternal magic trees to obtain fragments

Players with level 100+ woodcutting can get guaranteed bird's nests by making use of Lumberjack's Intuition when cutting eternal magic trees. 
When chopping these trees, a stream of falling leaves might appear on a side that the player isn't currently using. When this happens, a sound effect is heard, and when any one of the three tiles on that side of the tree is stood in and the tree is chopped down, the player will gain the Lumberjack's Intuition buff. Activating Lumberjack's Intuition within the first nine seconds will guarantee a bird's nest.
Bird's nests can be gathered more quickly by chopping a different eternal magic tree immediately after gaining the guaranteed bird's nest. Chopping another tree will end the buff, allowing the falling leaves to potentially start appear again. This means the player can gain two guaranteed bird's nests within 30 seconds.
The following is a highly approximate estimate and based on average player droprate for the fragments without utilising the Lumberjack's Intuition buff every 30 seconds.
